thread:
Maya: quick sync on adding auth-path tags so Console can show routing & quota by auth origin. current per-route dashboard doesn't explain why traffic moved between capacity tiers.
Ryan: customers confuse fallback billing; we need per-request attribution, even if sampled.
Deva: proposal: auth resolver emits an internal header `x-rwd-auth-path` (enum) + `x-rwd-auth-hash` (hashed id) on the request envelope. these are for internal telemetry only.
Sarah: important: add at the auth-proxy layer to avoid extra RPCs. auth resolver already computes the path but doesn't forward it. cheap to include in envelope metadata.
Katie: UX/Docs: Console should show a small "Auth origin" breakdown on the route overview card (pie or bar), with a filter to only show org/project/sa. Also add an "explain" modal for support.
Maya: agree. minimal rollout: emit the headers but only sample 0.1% of requests to observe cardinality. bump to 1%/10% as we validate.
Ryan: metric naming: `billing.auth_path.tokens` (counter) with labels: auth_bucket, model_variant, region. sample metric emission initially. avoid using PII in labels.
Deva: we'll hash email-like SA names and map to short stable suffixes (e.g., sa_h:abcd). keep top-K list on backend and drop low-frequency items.
Sarah: ops checklist: ensure metric cardinality cap (100) and retention: 30d hot, archive longer. add a flag `auth_path_tagging` to control sampling.
Katie: timeline: land headers + sampled metric in the proxy this week; Console tile mock next week. Who owns which bits?
Deva: backend metrics + schema. Maya: Console mock and UX. Sarah: perf + infra sign-off and watch for SLO impact. Ryan: alerts and monitoring. Katie: internal doc + support FAQ.
Maya: alerting rules suggestion?
Ryan: page if: top auth_bucket token count shifts >20% vs 1h baseline for 5m, or unique auth_bucket count >200% growth in 1h. Also alert on cardinality approaching cap.
Sarah: playbook entry: if alerts fire, flip `auth_path_tagging` sampling to 0 and roll back the proxy change.
Katie: reminder: don't expose header publicly. changelog only mentions 'improved internal routing telemetry'.
Deva: implementation note: traces will carry the full resolution for internal debugging; metrics only carry hashed buckets. keep mapping in a secure internal store.
Maya: cool. let's sync in 48h. ops-bot: "deploy queued: auth-proxy v2 -> canary 10%"
Maya: thanks everyone.
